defs.def: next to or at the side of sth 在 … 旁边；沿着 … 的边

ex.s: Ehlers   41   about the small dog he had seen   42   alongside the road.
ex.t: 埃勒斯____41____他在路边____42____看到的那只小狗。

ex.s: A bit later, they spotted what they, too, assumed was a dog running alongside a man on a bike.
ex.t: 过了一会儿，他们也看到了那个他们原以为是一只狗、正和骑车人并肩奔跑的东西。

ex.s: But when he put all of his effort on, starting it well out before the fish came alongside and pulling with all his strength, the fish pulled part way over and then righted himself and swam away.
ex.t: 但是，当他全力以赴时，在鱼儿走过来之前就开始了，用尽全力拉着鱼儿，鱼儿中途停了下来，然后挺身而出，游走了。

defs.def: together with or at the same time as sth/sb 与 … 一起；与 … 同时

ex.s: The western half of the US was full of grizzlies when Europeans came, with a rough number of 50,000 or more living alongside Native Americans.
ex.t: 当欧洲人到来时，美国西部半壁到处都是灰熊，大约有5万只或更多与美洲原住民比邻而居。

ex.s: As they sat in a restaurant alongside the broad St Lawrence River, a young man sat down with them.
ex.t: 他们坐在宽阔的圣劳伦斯河边的一家餐馆里，一个年轻人和他们坐在一起。

ex.s: The Neanderthals   9  （live）alongside human ancestors in Europe for tens of thousands of years, before dying out about 40, 000 years ago.
ex.t: 尼安德特人与人类祖先在欧洲共存了数万年，大约在四万年前灭绝。

ex.s: Granddaughter Gayle Parks，31-who works alongside her in the family business-said it remained unknown as to who nominated Irene for the award.
ex.t: 31岁的孙女盖尔·帕克斯——她在家族企业中和奶奶一起工作——说目前还不清楚是谁提名艾琳参选这个奖项的。

ex.s: This ongoing journey is allowing China to share the fruits of its success and develop further alongside other countries.
ex.t: 这一持续的旅程使中国能够分享其成功的成果，并与其他国家一起进一步发展。

ex.s: The Jiaolong even holds the record for the deepest dive by a manned submarine, at 7,062 metres, giving China its place alongside the world’s top ocean explorers.
ex.t: “礁龙号”甚至拥有载人潜艇潜水深度最深的记录，潜水高度为7,062米，使中国与世界顶级海洋探险家并驾齐驱。

ex.s: Alongside this, he became a passionate and 8 advocate for others suffering similar injuries and raised millions for medical research.
ex.t: 除此之外，他还成为一名充满激情的人，并倡导其他遭受类似伤害的人，并为医学研究筹集了数百万美元。
